_comment: Single source of truth for consensus-affecting constants whose drift between C++ and Rust would cause silent wrong-output (rather than fail-closed-on-load). Generated into both languages by cmake/generate_consensus_constants.py (C++) and rust/shekyl-engine-core/build.rs / rust/shekyl-difficulty/build.rs (Rust). Hand-maintained values on either side have been deleted and replaced with `static_assert` sentinels against the generated values. Bug class motivated by Bug 3 of the 2026-05-05 FFI constant-drift audit (see docs/audit_trail/2026-05-ffi-constant-drift-audit.md). Adding entries: keep the audit doc's 'Constants confirmed aligned' table in sync with this file.
_comment_daa: LWMA-1 difficulty adjustment parameters per docs/completed/DAA_LWMA1.md §4. Consumed by rust/shekyl-difficulty (Phase 1, ratified 2026-05-18). Window-shape constants only: N, T, FTL, MTP window length, and the genesis difficulty constant. The bias factor 99/200, the solvetime clamp 6, and the min-L floor 1/20 deliberately do NOT live here per the Round 3 disposition (DAA_LWMA1.md §4) — they appear as bare integer literals inside src/lwma1.rs because changing them is a deviation from the canonical zawy12 reference, not a tunable parameter.
_comment_archival: Per-shard archival retention bond floor (ARCHIVAL_BOND_FLOOR). Calibrated from bond_rate* = 0.75 per docs/design/FOUNDATION_GENESIS_IDENTITY_SET.md §9.3 (1 sim capital unit ≡ 1 SKL). Foundation CompleteTree holders post one nominal bond at this floor.
_comment_archival_timing: Archival timing cluster per docs/design/ARCHIVAL_TIMING_CONSTANTS.md §6 (pinned 2026-06-07). max_claim_age_w wired into KEYS_INTEGER / generate_consensus_constants.py (ArchivalBondValue v4 decode invariants) and rust/shekyl-archival-retention/build.rs; remaining keys wire at their consumers during PHASE_2B implementation.
_comment_archival_reward_curve: Provisional banded PL Curve (REWARD_EMISSION_LEG.md §4). Milli scale; stressnet reopening clause. plateau_work = 2 × plateau_value.
_comment_archival_reward_age_weight: g(age) slope on relative-depth age (ARCHIVAL_REWARD_ARITHMETIC.md §Shard age). Sealed target g* ≈ 2; calibration band [1500, 2500] per the Layer-2 margin-robustness run (STAKER_ARCHIVAL_SIM.md).
_comment_archival_launch: M1 reward-gate cover threshold (ARCHIVAL_REWARD_GATE_M1.md §4). PROVISIONAL — NOT GENESIS-READY: k_cover finalizes only from the WI-4 §14.4 partition run (widened hypothesis class) feeding the dynamic cover model; the genesis-readiness checklist (WI-4 §13.5) carries the finalization as a blocker. While k_cover_provisional is true, the ONLY permitted k_cover value is 0 — the gate-identity degenerate whose semantics the G-9 KAT pins executably (frozen_shard_count < 0 is never true, so pre-seal behavior is exactly the pre-gate behavior and the r_market/sigma store paths stay exercised end-to-end). A plausible-looking provisional value is unrepresentable, not merely discouraged: rust/shekyl-archival-retention/build.rs refuses any other provisional value, refuses a sealed 0, and shekyl-archival-retention refuses to compile without the explicit provisional-k-cover feature acknowledgment — the shipping guard is the compile refusal, never the sentinel value. Sealing: set the §14.4-derived value (>= 1), flip k_cover_provisional to false, and delete the provisional-k-cover feature machinery (deletion target named in the spec §4).
